### The Strangest Thing Jesus Said
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-strangest-thing-jesus-said
Passage: John 7:46
Points:
- Temple officers sent to arrest Jesus returned empty-handed because of His peerless speech.
- Throughout world history, no other human voice has exerted such enduring, widespread influence.
- The most startling and profound aspect of Jesus' teaching was His explicit claim to be God.
- Through His bold "I am" statements, Jesus revealed Himself as the divine Messiah and source of eternal life.
- The historical reality of the empty tomb confirms His divine authority and compels each person to decide who He is.
